summary: Frontend-only visual regression test of /catalogue filter pills after CSS fix. Verified computed styles across default, hover (inactive), active, and active+hover states for all 7 Category filter pills via Playwright. Bug is FIXED: active pills on hover now retain dark background (rgb(13,11,9)) + light text (rgb(244,239,230)) instead of becoming invisible. Border-radius is 999px (pill shape) on all pills. Clicking categories correctly filters the grid and updates catalogue-result-count. No JS console errors observed.

verification_details.default_state: transparent bg + dark ink text (rgb(13,11,9)) over light paper page bg — readable
verification_details.hover_inactive: bg rgba(10,10,10,0.05) + dark ink text — readable (fix confirmed: hover no longer forces light text)
verification_details.active: bg rgb(13,11,9) + light paper text rgb(244,239,230) — readable
verification_details.active_hover: bg rgb(13,11,9) + light paper text rgb(244,239,230) — readable (PRIMARY BUG FIXED; .filter-pill--active:hover now overrides)
verification_details.count_note: All individual category counts match exactly. ALL shows 41 (actual DB total: 6+4+18+4+1+8 = 41 across the six listed categories; the 28 in the request appears outdated and is NOT a regression from the CSS fix).
